command: PATH="$PWD/build/frontend-node-24.20.0-npm-11.19.0.BpJuvR/node/bin:$PATH" ./gradlew --no-daemon -x verifyFrontendToolchain test --tests 'decompengine.web.UploadServerTest.HTTP job status remains responsive while a multi-record dashboard listing is stalled'
test: HTTP job status remains responsive while a multi-record dashboard listing is stalled
scope: Local deterministic HTTP regression: one dashboard request is held in a physical job.json metadata read while eight GET /api/jobs/{id} requests each require HTTP 200 in under 2 seconds; after release the dashboard must include all three jobs.
limitations: Does not measure sustained-load throughput or physical-disk contention.
Does not qualify live deployment behavior or hosted CI.
Does not complete the broader #162 upload/listing quota matrix or issue acceptance.
